Hi Lauren — quick pass from product/solutions:

Notes on the checklist (page refs match the attached PDF):
- Page 2, "What to capture": add a line for "session id + model version" (very helpful for post-demo triage).
- Page 2, network note: call out the expected token latency at 8k context vs 2k context for the curated models (we should give a ballpark in ms so AE can set expectations).
- Page 3, fallback copy: suggest replacing "service degraded" with "If responses exceed 2s, fall back to summary mode" — more actionable.

Permissions: happy to include the masked screenshot approach. For screenshots of customer portals, please add a short blurb that the screenshot is only used in marketing collateral and requires written consent (one-sentence template included below).

One-sentence consent template (suggested):
"I authorize Redwood Inference to use masked screenshots of our portal for marketing and event collateral; no PII will be disclosed."

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the checklist.

—Ben
